description: Checks whether AI crawlers can read one public web page and whether the page is set up to be cited. For the exact URL path it evaluates the domain's robots.txt for 8 AI robots (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, CCBot, Applebot-Extended), each as allowed, blocked or no-rule (no rule for that robot or *, so allowed by default), or unknown when robots.txt could not be read; it checks for a valid /llms.txt (title, link count); and it reads the page's JSON-LD for citable types (Article, BlogPosting, FAQPage, HowTo…) and the fields that are missing (author Person with url, datePublished, dateModified, Organization.sameAs). Each part has a verdict (pass, warn, fail, info). Works without signing in and without a property: it fetches three public URLs of the site (the page, /robots.txt, /llms.txt) and stores nothing. Only public http/https addresses on the standard ports are accepted; private, local and internal addresses return invalid_argument. Use it to answer "can GPTBot / ClaudeBot / PerplexityBot read this page", "does this site have llms.txt" or "does this page have the structured data to be cited". It does not measure traffic or rankings. / Checa, sem login, se os robôs de IA podem ler uma página pública (robots.txt no caminho exato, llms.txt e JSON-LD de citação); não mede tráfego nem posição. Docs: https://organiqgeo.com/docs#check_ai_access

url.description: Public page address, e.g. example.com/blog/post or https://example.com/blog/post. The robots.txt rules are evaluated for this exact path.

name: check_ai_access
title: AI crawler access check
